environment: Windows, Node 24.16.0, same Electron/Vite development instance on 5175/9222, StrictMode unchanged, same existing database and expanded history, CDP focus emulation enabled for both stages, no CPU throttle or CPU/React profiler
metric: Capture-phase actual click to MutationObserver confirming Redux mode, sidebar work-tree visibility, corresponding home caption mode and sidebar content rows. Separate next requestAnimationFrame is not screen presentation.
protocol: After each source HMR settle 3 seconds, clear and save original selected session, show Cowork and settle 5 seconds. Four warm-up switches then 16 measured switches (8 per direction). Wait 1200ms between interactions, outside the measured interval. Restore original session/mode/view. No requests sent or sessions deleted. No lint/tests/build during measured stages.
limitations: Sequential A/B on a shared desktop; OS load is uncontrolled, no randomized trial or production-build benchmark.
HMR resets in-memory preview pagination: controlled stages both use 53 work rows and 20 chat rows; final selected-session restoration returns to 64 work rows.

Warm empty-session Cowork page. Clearing an incompatible selected session and live stream/unread changes legitimately update work history; those paths have regression coverage but no performance claim.
Chat history still mounts on entry and model configuration broadcasts remain unchanged; remaining latency is not attributed without separate measurements.
